build_pybind11_extension: build a C++11+ extension module using Pybind11Extension with automatic compiler flags for the target platform
build_pybind11_extensions_with_build_ext: build pybind11 extensions using the customized build_ext class that auto-detects the highest supported C++ standard level
generate_intree_extensions: generate Pybind11Extension objects from source files located directly in a Python source tree using intree_extensions
enable_parallel_compile: enable parallel compilation of C++ sources using ParallelCompile with configurable thread count via environment variable
check_compiler_flag_support: check if a specific compiler flag is supported using has_flag by compiling a test file with the flag
